## AI Regulation (EU AI Act)

- [European Commission](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/library/draft-commission-guidelines-classification-high-risk-ai-systems) | Draft guidelines on classifying high-risk AI systems published; public consultation open until June 23, 2026
  - **POV**: The 8 high-risk sectors (biometrics, critical infrastructure, employment, essential services, etc.) are where Article 6 classification fights will land. If you deploy AI in any of these, map your systems against the draft now, the consultation window is your chance to flag misclassification before the interpretation hardens.
- [Lewis Silkin](https://www.lewissilkin.com/insights/2026/05/29/eu-ai-act-guidance-on-classifying-high-risk-ai-systems-102mx9l) | EU AI Act: guidance on classifying high-risk AI systems
  - **POV**: Practical classification walkthrough. Useful to hand to product teams who think "our AI isn't high-risk" without checking the annexes.
- [Hunton Andrews Kurth](https://www.hunton.com/privacy-and-cybersecurity-law-blog/european-commission-releases-draft-guidelines-on-high-risk-ai-under-the-eu-ai-act) | European Commission Releases Draft Guidelines on High-Risk AI
  - **POV**: Not legally binding, but it is the Commission's enforcement lens. Treat it as the rubric regulators will actually grade against.
- [Latham & Watkins](https://www.lw.com/en/insights/ai-act-update-eu-resolves-to-change-rules-and-extend-deadlines) | AI Act Update: EU Resolves to Change Rules and Extend Deadlines
  - **POV**: Deadline shifts matter for compliance roadmaps. Confirm which obligations moved before you re-sequence your AI Act workplan; full enforcement still tracks to August 2, 2026.

## US State Privacy

- [IAPP](https://iapp.org/news/a/new-year-new-rules-us-state-privacy-requirements-coming-online-as-2026-begins) | New state privacy requirements coming online as 2026 begins
  - **POV**: 20 comprehensive state laws now in effect or landing this year. The compliance cost is no longer "California plus a few," it is a genuine 20-state patchwork. Build to the strictest common denominator.
- [BDO](https://www.bdo.com/insights/advisory/2026-is-a-pivotal-year-for-privacy) | 2026 is a Pivotal Year for Privacy (CCPA expansion: ADMT, risk assessments, cyber audits)
  - **POV**: The CCPA's new automated-decision-making opt-outs and mandatory privacy risk assessments are the operational lift this year. If you use ADMT in anything that "substantially replaces" human decisions, the opt-out plumbing needs to exist now.
- [Smith Anderson](https://www.smithlaw.com/newsroom/publications/data-privacy-in-2026-state-enforcement-takes-center-stage) | Data Privacy in 2026: State Enforcement Takes Center Stage
  - **POV**: Regulators are shifting from rule-making to enforcing what is already on the books. The CPPA and state AGs are signaling teeth. Posture accordingly.

## Healthcare Privacy

- [HIPAA Journal](https://www.hipaajournal.com/final-rule-implementing-hipaa-security-rule-updates-edges-closer/) | Final Rule Implementing HIPAA Security Rule Updates Edges Closer
  - **POV**: The proposed update makes encryption and MFA mandatory (drops the "addressable" dodge), adds 72-hour incident reporting, and pushes direct business-associate liability with annual written verification. If you are a BA or use them, the verification obligation is a new contracting and diligence workflow, not just a security checkbox.

## Cybersecurity (Financial Sector / Frontier AI)

- [NYDFS](https://www.dfs.ny.gov/industry-guidance/industry-letters/20260521-heightened-cybersecurity-risks-assoc-with-frontier-ai-models) | Industry Letter: Heightened Cybersecurity Risks from Frontier AI Models (May 21, 2026)
  - **POV**: The primary-source letter. NYDFS frames frontier AI as a threat-actor accelerant for finding and exploiting vulnerabilities. Even if you are not NY-regulated, this is a preview of where financial-sector cyber expectations are heading.
- [Alston & Bird](https://www.alstonprivacy.com/nydfs-issues-frontier-ai-advisory-and-guidance-for-heightened-cyber-threat-environment/) | NYDFS Issues Frontier AI Advisory and Guidance for Heightened Cyber Threat Environment
  - **POV**: Clean breakdown of the three buckets (reduce attack surface, threat detection/readiness, resilience/response). A good gap-check checklist against your 23 NYCRR 500 program.
- [Davis Wright Tremaine](https://www.dwt.com/blogs/privacy--security-law-blog/2026/05/nydfs-frontier-ai-cyber-risk-guidance) | NYDFS Issues Guidance on Frontier AI Cyber Risks
  - **POV**: Pairs the cyber guidance with the broader heightened-threat-environment letter. Note the third-party dependency-mapping ask, vendor risk is squarely in scope.

## EU Data Protection (GDPR Enforcement)

- [Covington (Inside Privacy)](https://www.insideprivacy.com/eu-data-protection/edpb-to-focus-on-transparency-in-2026-enforcement/) | EDPB to Focus on Transparency in 2026 Enforcement
  - **POV**: The 2026 Coordinated Enforcement Framework targets transparency and information obligations (GDPR Articles 12-14). Translation: your privacy notices and "how we use your data" disclosures are the audit surface this year. Re-paper them.
- [EDPB](https://www.edpb.europa.eu/news/news/2026/cef-2026-edpb-launches-coordinated-enforcement-action-transparency-and-information_en) | CEF 2026: coordinated enforcement action on transparency and information obligations
  - **POV**: Primary source for the above. Coordinated action means multiple DPAs probing the same theme at once, expect a wave, not a one-off.
